startCommand: docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml up -d && (nohup ops/fetch-media.sh > /tmp/fetch-media.log 2>&1 &) ; true

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for the on-site assistant chat (functions/chat.js). Only needed if you want the chat assistant to work; the static site renders without it. Get it from the Anthropic Console at console.anthropic.com.
